name: Vegas Style Slots
summary: Vegas Style Slots is the tri-state area's largest dealer of authentic Las Vegas casino slot machines, offering an extensive selection of both vintage reel slots and modern video slots. The Fort Mohave showroom features popular brands like IGT, Konami, Williams, and Aristocrat, along with full service and repair capabilities.
demographics: Vegas Style Slots attracts a diverse customer base primarily consisting of gaming enthusiasts and collectors aged 35-65 with middle to upper-middle income levels. The Fort Mohave area draws visitors from the tri-state region (Arizona, Nevada, and California), including retirees and gaming hobbyists who appreciate authentic casino equipment. The customer base includes both serious collectors seeking rare vintage machines and casual buyers looking for home entertainment, with many traveling specifically to visit the showroom from Las Vegas and surrounding communities.
description: Vegas Style Slots stands as the largest slot machine dealer in the tri-state area, offering an impressive collection of authentic casino slot machines straight from the Las Vegas casino floors. Located at 5287 Highway 95 in Fort Mohave, Arizona, this specialized showroom has built a reputation for stocking the most up-to-date slot machines available on the market. The business specializes in both vintage reel slots and modern video slots, featuring popular titles like IGT Double Triple Diamond, Konami China Shores, Williams BB2 dual screens, and Aristocrat Buffalo machines. With an extensive inventory that includes arcade tables, new arrivals, replacement parts, and rare finds, Vegas Style Slots caters to collectors, gaming enthusiasts, and those looking to bring the Vegas experience into their homes. The company provides comprehensive services including sales, repair, and shipping, making it a one-stop destination for anyone seeking genuine casino-quality gaming equipment.
